dct_description_sm: This project consisted of outreach sessions aimed at developing an early version of the Canadian Standards Association (CSA)'s permafrost guidelines. The objectives were: (1) to raise awareness and encourage management of northern community infrastructure according to commonly-accepted best practices for the assessment and management of permafrost and climate change-related risks and vulnerabilities; (2) to receive input from the eventual end-users of the Permafrost Guideline in order to inform the tone, content and emphasis used in creating this tool; and (3) to reflect back to northerners how the Permafrost Guideline will address their needs and to emphasize the importance of updating the Guideline regularly.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Outreach Sessions Related to the Development of a National Guideline on Permafrost, Climate Change and Community Infrastructure
